'''2017 U.S. National Championship''' was the Players Committee U.S. National Championship, 23–25 June 2017. [[Chris Kelly]] is published first on the Day 2 list.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' United States
* '''Dates:''' 23–25 June 2017
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Kelly]]
